en: A colorized postcard view of a tranquil waterfront scene in a small village. There is a calm bay or river in the foreground with two small wooden boats, one with a sail and one with several people on board. On the opposite shore stand light-colored stone houses with red-tiled roofs surrounded by tall trees and greenery. The scene is peaceful and rural, with soft pastel tones. Printed text at the top left names the location, and a website watermark appears at the bottom right.
